id: title:DanielVisca:add overview tab with ingestion status and service rollup

review.posthog_relevance: Adds backend ingestion freshness and inventory counts, frontend tab, and API support for a metrics overview page.
review.reason: The change implements a bounded, substantive capability: a new metrics overview page with backend ingestion freshness and inventory counts, complete with API endpoints, TypeScript interfaces, and comprehensive tests. This represents a clear, bounded improvement rather than a narrow maintenance task, warranting a score of 2. No systemic risk reduction or broader capability expansion
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation and test coverage, but the actual user benefit and adoption are not demonstrated. No tier assignment is requested, only observations.
